dialogues.speaker: Sumi
dialogues.text: I used to work at Tatarasuna. Yuuzou rescued me from the ruins after the disaster — straight up saved my life.

dialogues.speaker: Sumi
dialogues.text: I have no obligations to Sangonomiya and can leave here at any time. But I've been through life-and-death situations with everyone here... I won't be separated from them again.
